snippet.title: Dungeons & Donuts Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Dungeons & Donuts is a co-op action RPG where bullet hell dungeons meet a cozy village full of baked goods. Think Vampire Survivors meets Path of Exile 2.

Dive into roguelite dungeon runs with up to 4 players online, or go solo. Dodge, roll and jump through bullet storms, then head home to sell your loot, tend the farm, grow your village and cook donuts that change your next run. One turns corpses into screen-filling mines. Another stacks speed with every kill until you blur across the map.

Made by two people at Sas & Sons Game Studio.

Out now in Steam Early Access at founder pricing:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4764560/Dungeons__Donuts/

Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/VMuMmZrZEX
X: https://x.com/DungeonsNDonuts
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dungeons_donuts
